text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(If I wanna beat 'em, it's gotta be now!!
I've gotta risk my damn life right this second!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Inari One! Inari One!!
Inari One crosses the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *gasp*... *pant*...—
I... I did it... you bastards...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Heheh... I can barely stand...!
It still feels like the pressure from those guys is piercing my entire body...!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta admit, I totally misjudged your running.
Today's a complete defeat for me."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, staying defeated just ain't in my nature.
I'll definitely beat you to a pulp one day.
Look forward to it when that time comes.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let us compete again at next year's Tenno Sho (Autumn), Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah...! Next time for sure...
let's settle this at Tokyo Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Heheh... Looks like we just made a massive promise for next year...!)
